competency_fulfillment.rationale: The counting-up framing is right and the arithmetic is sound throughout, but the number line is the representation this competency is named for and only three of the sixteen seeds involve one. The rest are bare start-and-count instructions that a learner can answer by mental addition without ever picturing a line, so the illustrative model is optional in most of the set.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Counts that stay inside the current ten and counts that cross into the next one are both well represented, which is the distinction that matters for counting up. Starting values are spread across the whole two-digit range from the teens to the nineties, and the added amount covers the full span of one-digit values.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Counting on by fewer than ten from a two-digit start is precisely the early Quarter 1 addition strategy, and the stems are two short imperative sentences. The error-detection items add a checking step without adding numerical load, since the underlying computation remains a small count on.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Six distinct response types occur here, including judging another pupil's stated answer, marking a sum on a line, and a rendered item about a dot moving forward. Both the compute-the-landing-point and verify-the-landing-point orientations are generated, which is real breadth for a narrow skill.

competency_alignment.rationale: The dimension that varies is whether the count crosses a ten boundary, which is exactly what makes counting up harder or easier, together with the size of the one-digit jump. Both operands stay in the shapes the competency names, with two-digit starting points and one-digit increments in every item.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Starts range from 15 to 95 and increments from 1 to 9, keeping strictly to the 2-digit and 1-digit pairing the wording specifies. One seed starting at 94 and counting up 7 lands just past a hundred, which is a boundary case worth noting but remains inside the Grade 2 Quarter 1 number range.
